subject: Contractual remedy request — confirmed latency window and RCA timeline
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greenlinepay.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@greenlinepay.com, tom.reynolds@greenlinepay.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Major latency spike 2028-05-22 — seeking remedy and logs

Hi Laura / Marissa,

We observed a sustained spike in end-to-end latency on 2028-05-22 between 09:03 and 09:46 PDT that affected tokenization and authorization flows for our payment auth path. Roughly 18% of requests retried; several timed out and caused failed settlements. Our SREs pulled a high-level timeline and the attached samples.

Greenline Pay references the SLA section in our contract (Section 4.2) and is requesting:
- confirmation of the impacted window(s) and classification (downtime vs degradation)
- preliminary eligibility for contract remedies / service credits
- a commitment for a post-incident RCA and delivery timeline so we can report to our compliance team

Can Redwood confirm receipt and provide the window verification by EOD PT? We also need any raw traces you can share, or a link to a log bundle we can use for cross-correlation.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Ops, Greenline Pay
attachments: greenline_request_samples.jsonl (jsonl), slo-analysis-20280522.csv (csv)

--- Forwarded message attached below ---

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: infra-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Major latency spike 2028-05-22 — seeking remedy and logs

Laura / Karthik — putting together an initial pulse. Observed a transient increase in queueing on the model frontends during 09:07–09:40 PDT. KPIs: 95th/99th token latency both jumped, and there was a brief token-generation slowdown correlated with a surge of authorization retries from Greenline (their upstream client retried on 408s).

I attached a short CSV with aggregated SLO checks across the period (slo-analysis-20280522.csv). Short summary:
- Primary window: 2028-05-22 09:07:12–09:39:58 PDT
- Error class: increased 504/408s on gateway and elevated tail latency (degradation, not total outage)
- Root cause hypothesis (prelim): auth upstream retries triggered a KV-cache miss storm that amplified queuing into the serving pool

Next steps I recommend:
1) Share the confirmed window and classification (degradation) with Greenline — keep wording conservative.
2) Prepare a log bundle and pcap for their team: s3://redwood-logs/glp/2028-05-22/log-bundle-987654.tar.gz
3) Start a formal RCA — ETA 5 business days for draft, 10 days for final with remediation plan.

Sean Gallagher
Sr. Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greenlinepay.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greenlinepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Major latency spike 2028-05-22 — seeking remedy and logs

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks for the samples. Short update from our side:

- Confirmed impacted window: 2028-05-22 09:07:12–09:39:58 PDT.
- Classification: degraded performance (not a complete outage) driven by elevated tail latency and intermediate gateway timeouts.
- Log bundle: s3://redwood-logs/glp/2028-05-22/log-bundle-987654.tar.gz (we will share a short-form set immediately; full traces available on request)
- Proposed remedy process: we will evaluate eligibility for contract remedies under Section 4.2 once the RCA finalizes the impact calculation. Preliminary eligibility: likely partial credit due to sustained degradation affecting throughput; final amount requires final impact calc.

We will deliver a draft RCA in 5 business days (by 2028-05-29) and a finalized RCA + remediation plan in 10 business days (by 2028-06-05). If you need a faster cadence we can schedule a sync tomorrow to walk through the logs.

Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: s3 link, short summary file reference

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greenlinepay.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, sara.patel@greenlinepay.com
Cc: ops@greenlinepay.com
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Major latency spike 2028-05-22 — seeking remedy and logs

Laura / team — thanks for the fast confirmation. Two asks from Greenline Compliance:
1) For accounting/controls we need an itemized request showing the calculation inputs you will use for eligibility (request volume baseline, impacted request count, credit formula).
2) Our legal team will likely request a formal statement about whether this event meets the SLA "unavailability" definition. Please mark clearly if your determination is "not an outage" and provide the language you will sign off on.

We'd like the draft RCA and the calculation inputs by close of business Friday (2028-05-26). If you cannot make that date please let us know immediately so we can escalate internally.

—Tom

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greenlinepay.com>, tom.reynolds@greenlinepay.com
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Major latency spike 2028-05-22 — seeking remedy and logs

Tom / Sara / team — following up with the commercial & legal view.

1) Classification language we can commit to for the record: "Redwood's investigation classifies the 2028-05-22 09:07–09:40 PDT event as a service degradation that materially impacted performance; it does not meet the contractual definition of 'unavailability' under Section 4.1." Please confirm this phrasing is acceptable to Greenline's legal counsel.

2) Calculation inputs (high level) we will include in the draft:
   - baseline request rate: computed from trailing 30-day average (UTC window aligned)
   - impacted request count: requests within the confirmed window with error/timeout status
   - credit formula: per-contract formula in Section 4.2 applied to the proportion of impacted requests over billing period; examples attached in the draft

3) Timeline: we will deliver a draft RCA + calculation appendix by 2028-05-26 EOB as requested. Full final RCA with remediation plan by 2028-06-05.

If Greenline prefers a joint readout tomorrow (2028-05-25) we have availability 10:00–11:30 PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
attachments: draft-credit-calculator-example.xlsx
